excerpt: This technical how-to builds a conversational claims assistant on Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases that answers natural-language questions with citations. It covers ingesting claim documents from Amazon S3, querying with the AgenticRetrieveStream API, multi-turn follow-ups, metadata filters, and contextual grounding guardrails.
